01-authorized.png.headline: It reads only the folders you authorize
01-authorized.png.subline: The App Store edition runs inside the system sandbox. Authorize once, revoke any time.

02-scanned.png.headline: Every item shows its size and its risk
02-scanned.png.subline: Only what you can re-fetch within 5 minutes is pre-selected. Big items are never ticked for you.

03-confirm.png.headline: You see exactly what goes, before it goes
03-confirm.png.subline: How many items, how much space — and plainly stated: this cannot be undone, and nothing goes to the Trash.

04-cleaned.png.headline: Exactly how much you got back
04-cleaned.png.subline: All of it happens on your Mac. No account, no analytics, no ads.

05-history.png.headline: Every step is logged and checkable
05-history.png.subline: The log lives only on your Mac, and goes away with the app.
